title: HIV2 Coverage Audit
subhead: HIV-2 and the simian immunodeficiency viruses
standfirst: HIV2 is a module name, not a taxon. It holds HIV-2 and the SIVs together, and it is majority SIV: 1,660 of its 2,113 collection sequences and 65 of its 110 coverage exemplars come from simian immunodeficiency virus, not from HIV-2. The module is separated from HIV-1 on layout rather than distance — the two differ by one accessory gene, vpx here against vpu there, which is the project's partitioning rule.

sections.title: What the module calls
sections.lede: Nine features on one 9.8 kb provirus, seven called by profile and two by the splice caller.

blocks.html: Nine features: gag, pol, vif, vpx, vpr, env and nef from PSSMs, tat and rev from get_splice_variant_features.pl. vpx is a gene duplication of vpr and exists only in the HIV-2/SIVsmm/SIVmac lineage; both are declared and neither calls the other.

sections.title: Where it does not call, and why

blocks.html: VPR is called on 72.7% of exemplars and that is biology, not a gap. Thirty of the 110 genomes carry a single accessory gene in a 311 nt window where the rest carry two in 630 nt, and the BV-BRC reference annotation agrees those genomes have no vpr. VPR therefore carries no copy_num. The held-out panel read 95% because it is mostly HIV-2; the coverage set carries the full SIV spread.

99.8% of the 6069 deposited features from this module's taxa are bound by a naming rule. The remainder are recorded in UNASSIGNED and DISCARDED: the first is vocabulary no rule reached, the second is records the source itself calls partial or truncated, which the project discards rather than trains on.

Coverage is measured by annotating de-replicated exemplars through the real GTO pipeline — annotate_by_viral_pssm-GTO.pl, then the transcript-edit and splice passes, then viral_genome_quality.pl — not by a reimplementation. Spliced features are included, which the flat feature-table path cannot represent. Rates are per exemplar, and exemplars are clustered at 95% nucleotide identity, so one row is one distinct sequence rather than one deposit.

source_note: Measured 27 October 2026 from the shipped module: the HIV2 block of Viral_PSSM.json, its profiles and collections, and the 27 October coverage re-annotation over 110 exemplars de-replicated from 693 genomes. Vocabulary figures come from collections/synonyms.tsv, written by the module's own builder from the naming rules, and count deposited features rather than unique sequences.
